000000000001000010000010001000
000000000001111110000011001000
000000000000000000000001001000
000000000000000000000001111000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000'''.splitlines()
assert len(s)==30 and all(len(r)==30 for r in s),[(i,len(r)) for i,r in enumerate(s) if len(r)!=30]
g=[list(map(int,r)) for r in s]
# flood-fill zero components using 4-neighborhood; identify enclosed regions
seen=set(); enclosed=[]; ext=set()
for i in range(30):
 for j in range(30):
  if g[i][j]==0 and (i,j) not in seen:
   comp=[]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); edge=False
   while q:
    x,y=q.popleft(); comp.append((x,y)); edge |= x in (0,29) or y in (0,29)
    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
     a,b=x+dx,y+dy
     if 0<=a<30 and 0<=b<30 and g[a][b]==0 and (a,b) not in seen:
      seen.add((a,b));q.append((a,b))
   (ext if edge else enclosed).append(comp)
for comp in enclosed:
 for x,y in comp:g[x][y]=3
# active 1 pixels 4-adjacent to enclosed zero region; as connected outlines likely component
active=set()
for i in range(30):
 for j in range(30):
  if g[i][j]==1:
   if any(0<=i+dx<30 and 0<=j+dy<30 and g[i+dx][j+dy]==3 for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))): active.add((i,j))
# extend active outline's 8-neighbor external zero halo to 2
# include all 1 pixels in 8-connected components that contain an active pixel
ones={(i,j) for i in range(30) for j in range(30) if g[i][j]==1}; vis=set(); activeall=set()
for p in ones:
 if p in vis:continue
 q=[p];vis.add(p);comp=[]
 while q:
  x,y=q.pop();comp.append((x,y))
  for dx in (-1,0,1):
   for dy in (-1,0,1):
    a,b=x+dx,y+dy
    if (a,b) in ones and (a,b) not in vis:vis.add((a,b));q.append((a,b))
 if any(z in active for z in comp):activeall.update(comp)
for x,y in activeall:
 for dx in (-1,0,1):
  for dy in (-1,0,1):
   a,b=x+dx,y+dy
   if 0<=a<30 and 0<=b<30 and g[a][b]==0:g[a][b]=2
print('enclosed',len(enclosed),[len(x) for x in enclosed], 'active 1s',len(activeall))
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in g))

from collections import deque
s='''000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000011111
000000000000000000000000010001
000000000000000000000000010001
000001111100000000111000110001
000001000111000000101000100001
000001000001000000101000111111
000001000001000000111000000000
000001111001000000000000000000
000000001001000000000000000000
000000001111000000000000000000
000000000000000000000111111000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000001111111110000111101000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001111000010000000000000
000000000001000010000011111000
000000000001000010000010001000
000000000001111110000011001000
000000000000000000000001001000
000000000000000000000001111000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000'''.splitlines(); a=[list(map(int,r)) for r in s]; R=C=30
# exterior zero flood fill with 8-connectivity
ext=set();q=deque()
for i in range(R):
 for j in range(C):
  if (i in(0,R-1) or j in(0,C-1)) and a[i][j]==0:ext.add((i,j));q.append((i,j))
while q:
 x,y=q.popleft()
 for dx in(-1,0,1):
  for dy in(-1,0,1):
   z=x+dx,y+dy
   if 0<=z[0]<R and 0<=z[1]<C and a[z[0]][z[1]]==0 and z not in ext:ext.add(z);q.append(z)
inside={(i,j) for i in range(R) for j in range(C) if a[i][j]==0 and (i,j) not in ext}
# output color inside 3, halo 2 for any 1 adjacent (8-neighbor) to inside (identify enclosed shapes), then halo around these boundary 1 components
ones={(i,j) for i in range(R) for j in range(C) if a[i][j]==1}; touch=set()
for i,j in ones:
 if any((i+dx,j+dy) in inside for dx in(-1,0,1) for dy in(-1,0,1)):touch.add((i,j))
# 4-connect components of ones so separate outline forms; include all components associated with inside
vis=set();sel=set()
for p in ones:
 if p in vis:continue
 q=[p];vis.add(p);comp=set()
 while q:
  x,y=q.pop();comp.add((x,y))
  for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
   z=x+dx,y+dy
   if z in ones and z not in vis:vis.add(z);q.append(z)
 if comp & touch:sel|=comp
out=[r[:] for r in a]
for x,y in inside:out[x][y]=3
for x,y in sel:
 for dx in(-1,0,1):
  for dy in(-1,0,1):
   z=x+dx,y+dy
   if 0<=z[0]<R and 0<=z[1]<C and a[z[0]][z[1]]==0 and z not in inside:out[z[0]][z[1]]=2
print('inside',len(inside),'selected ones',len(sel));print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))

from collections import deque
s='''000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000011111
000000000000000000000000010001
000000000000000000000000010001
000001111100000000111000110001
000001000111000000101000100001
000001000001000000101000111111
000001000001000000111000000000
000001111001000000000000000000
000000001001000000000000000000
000000001111000000000000000000
000000000000000000000111111000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000001111111110000111101000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001111000010000000000000
000000000001000010000011111000
000000000001000010000010001000
000000000001111110000011001000
000000000000000000000001001000
000000000000000000000001111000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000'''.splitlines(); a=[list(map(int,r)) for r in s];R=C=30
# Find 4-connected exterior zero component
ext=set();q=deque()
for i in range(R):
 for j in range(C):
  if (i in(0,29) or j in(0,29)) and a[i][j]==0:ext.add((i,j));q.append((i,j))
while q:
 x,y=q.popleft()
 for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
  z=x+dx,y+dy
  if 0<=z[0]<R and 0<=z[1]<C and a[z[0]][z[1]]==0 and z not in ext:ext.add(z);q.append(z)
inside={(i,j) for i in range(R) for j in range(C) if a[i][j]==0 and (i,j) not in ext}
# capture enclosed connected 0 regions to precisely separate gaps
seen=set();holes=[]
for p in inside:
 if p in seen:continue
 q=[p];seen.add(p);h=set()
 while q:
  x,y=q.pop();h.add((x,y))
  for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
   z=x+dx,y+dy
   if z in inside and z not in seen:seen.add(z);q.append(z)
 holes.append(h)
# For each hole, find associated boundary 1 connected component (4-connected)
ones={(i,j) for i in range(R) for j in range(C) if a[i][j]==1};vis=set();components=[]
for p in ones:
 if p in vis:continue
 q=[p];vis.add(p);co=set()
 while q:
  x,y=q.pop();co.add((x,y))
  for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
   z=x+dx,y+dy
   if z in ones and z not in vis:vis.add(z);q.append(z)
 components.append(co)
# for any 1 component adjacent to hole, fill whole hole color3. Outside halo = eight neighbors of shape's bounding rectangle? Actually demos show halo traces around 1 path, not bbox; use bbox perimeter only if shape has enclosed gap.
selected=[]
for co in components:
 if any(any((x+dx,y+dy) in h for x,y in co for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))) for h in holes): selected.append(co)
out=[r[:] for r in a]
for h in holes:
 for x,y in h:out[x][y]=3
for co in selected:
 # perimeter of bounding box, output 2 in zero cells around bbox
 r0=min(x for x,y in co);r1=max(x for x,y in co);c0=min(y for x,y in co);c1=max(y for x,y in co)
 for x in range(max(0,r0-1),min(R,r1+2)):
  for y in range(max(0,c0-1),min(C,c1+2)):
   if x in(r0-1,r1+1) or y in(c0-1,c1+1):
    if a[x][y]==0:out[x][y]=2
print('holes',[(len(h),min(x for x,y in h),max(x for x,y in h),min(y for x,y in h),max(y for x,y in h)) for h in holes]);print('['+','.join('['+','.join(map(str,r))+']' for r in out)+']')

from collections import deque
s='''000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000011111
000000000000000000000000010001
000000000000000000000000010001
000001111100000000111000110001
000001000111000000101000100001
000001000001000000101000111111
000001000001000000111000000000
000001111001000000000000000000
000000001001000000000000000000
000000001111000000000000000000
000000000000000000000111111000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000001111111110000111101000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001111000010000000000000
000000000001000010000011111000
000000000001000010000010001000
000000000001111110000011001000
000000000000000000000001001000
000000000000000000000001111000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000'''.splitlines();a=[list(map(int,r)) for r in s];R=C=30
# holes via 4conn zero; outlines relevant if adjacent
seen=set();holes=[]
for i in range(R):
 for j in range(C):
  if a[i][j]==0 and (i,j) not in seen:
   q=deque([(i,j)]);seen.add((i,j));co=set();edge=False
   while q:
    x,y=q.popleft();co.add((x,y));edge |= x in(0,29) or y in(0,29)
    for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
     z=x+dx,y+dy
     if 0<=z[0]<R and 0<=z[1]<C and a[z[0]][z[1]]==0 and z not in seen:seen.add(z);q.append(z)
   if not edge:holes.append(co)
# Object components are 4-connected ones, selected if touching any hole.
ones={(i,j) for i in range(R) for j in range(C) if a[i][j]==1};vis=set();selected=[]
for p in ones:
 if p in vis:continue
 q=[p];vis.add(p);co=set()
 while q:
  x,y=q.pop();co.add((x,y))
  for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
   z=x+dx,y+dy
   if z in ones and z not in vis:vis.add(z);q.append(z)
 if any((x+dx,y+dy) in h for x,y in co for h in holes for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):selected.append(co)
out=[r[:] for r in a]
# Inner outlines: fill every cavity cell adjacent to its boundary with 3, leaving interior holes unchanged.
for h in holes:
 for x,y in h:
  if any((x+dx,y+dy) in ones for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):out[x][y]=3
# Outer outline appears as rectangular 2 framing each loop's bounding box in demo 4, but demo 1's output halo is pixelwise. Use exact 8-neighbor dilation.
inside=set().union(*holes)
for co in selected:

from collections import deque
s='''000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000011111
000000000000000000000000010001
000000000000000000000000010001
000001111100000000111000110001
000001000111000000101000100001
000001000001000000101000111111
000001000001000000111000000000
000001111001000000000000000000
000000001001000000000000000000
000000001111000000000000000000
000000000000000000000111111000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000001111111110000111101000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001111000010000000000000
000000000001000010000011111000
000000000001000010000010001000
000000000001111110000011001000
000000000000000000000001001000
000000000000000000000001111000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000'''.splitlines();a=[list(map(int,r)) for r in s];R=C=30
# holes via 4conn zero; outlines relevant if adjacent
seen=set();holes=[]
for i in range(R):
 for j in range(C):
  if a[i][j]==0 and (i,j) not in seen:
   q=deque([(i,j)]);seen.add((i,j));co=set();edge=False
   while q:
    x,y=q.popleft();co.add((x,y));edge |= x in(0,29) or y in(0,29)
    for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
     z=x+dx,y+dy
     if 0<=z[0]<R and 0<=z[1]<C and a[z[0]][z[1]]==0 and z not in seen:seen.add(z);q.append(z)
   if not edge:holes.append(co)
# Object components are 4-connected ones, selected if touching any hole.
ones={(i,j) for i in range(R) for j in range(C) if a[i][j]==1};vis=set();selected=[]
for p in ones:
 if p in vis:continue
 q=[p];vis.add(p);co=set()
 while q:
  x,y=q.pop();co.add((x,y))
  for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
   z=x+dx,y+dy
   if z in ones and z not in vis:vis.add(z);q.append(z)
 if any((x+dx,y+dy) in h for x,y in co for h in holes for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):selected.append(co)
out=[r[:] for r in a]
# Inner outlines: fill every cavity cell adjacent to its boundary with 3, leaving interior holes unchanged.
for h in holes:
 for x,y in h:
  if any((x+dx,y+dy) in ones for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):out[x][y]=3
# Outer outline appears as rectangular 2 framing each loop's bounding box in demo 4, but demo 1's output halo is pixelwise. Use exact 8-neighbor dilation.
inside=set().union(*holes)
for co in selected:
 for x,y in co:
  for dx in(-1,0,1):
   for dy in(-1,0,1):
    z=x+dx,y+dy
    if 0<=z[0]<R and 0<=z[1]<C and a[z[0]][z[1]]==0 and z not in inside:out[z[0]][z[1]]=2
import json
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))

from collections import deque
s='''000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000011111
000000000000000000000000010001
000000000000000000000000010001
000001111100000000111000110001
000001000111000000101000100001
000001000001000000101000111111
000001000001000000111000000000
000001111001000000000000000000
000000001001000000000000000000
000000001111000000000000000000
000000000000000000000111111000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000001111111110000111101000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001111000010000000000000
000000000001000010000011111000
000000000001000010000010001000
000000000001111110000011001000
000000000000000000000001001000
000000000000000000000001111000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000'''.splitlines()
a=[list(map(int,r)) for r in s];R=C=30
# connected zero components, identify enclosed
seen=set();holes=[]
for i in range(R):
 for j in range(C):
  if a[i][j]==0 and (i,j) not in seen:
   q=deque([(i,j)]);seen.add((i,j));co=set();edge=False
   while q:
    x,y=q.popleft();co.add((x,y));edge|=x in(0,R-1) or y in(0,C-1)
    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
     z=x+dx,y+dy
     if 0<=z[0]<R and 0<=z[1]<C and a[z[0]][z[1]]==0 and z not in seen:seen.add(z);q.append(z)
   if not edge:holes.append(co)
inside=set().union(*holes) if holes else set()
# Selected 4-connected 1 components adjacent to hole
ones={(i,j) for i in range(R) for j in range(C) if a[i][j]==1};vis=set();selected=[]
for p in ones:
 if p in vis:continue
 q=[p];vis.add(p);co=set()
 while q:
  x,y=q.pop();co.add((x,y))
  for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
   z=x+dx,y+dy
   if z in ones and z not in vis:vis.add(z);q.append(z)
 if any((x+dx,y+dy) in inside for x,y in co for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):selected.extend(co)
out=[r[:] for r in a]
# Interior shell of cavities (zeros neighboring 1 orthogonally)
for x,y in inside:
 if any(a[x+dx][y+dy]==1 for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):out[x][y]=3
# Outside shell around linked contour using 8-neighborhood
for x,y in selected:
 for dx in (-1,0,1):
  for dy in (-1,0,1):
   u,v=x+dx,y+dy
   if 0<=u<R and 0<=v<C and a[u][v]==0 and (u,v) not in inside:out[u][v]=2
print('holes',[(len(h),(min(x for x,y in h),max(x for x,y in h),min(y for x,y in h),max(y for x,y in h))) for h in holes], 'selected',len(selected))
import json;print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))

from collections import deque
s='''000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000011111
000000000000000000000000010001
000000000000000000000000010001
000001111100000000111000110001
000001000111000000101000100001
000001000001000000101000111111
000001000001000000111000000000
000001111001000000000000000000
000000001001000000000000000000
000000001111000000000000000000
000000000000000000000111111000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000001111111110000111101000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001111000010000000000000
000000000001000010000011111000
000000000001000010000010001000
000000000001111110000011001000
000000000000000000000001001000
000000000000000000000001111000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000'''.splitlines();a=[list(map(int,r)) for r in s];R=C=30
# enclosed zero components
seen=set();holes=[]
for i in range(R):
 for j in range(C):
  if a[i][j]==0 and (i,j) not in seen:
   q=deque([(i,j)]);seen.add((i,j));h=set();edge=False
   while q:
    x,y=q.popleft();h.add((x,y));edge |= x in (0,29) or y in (0,29)
    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
     z=x+dx,y+dy
     if 0<=z[0]<R and 0<=z[1]<C and a[z[0]][z[1]]==0 and z not in seen:seen.add(z);q.append(z)
   if not edge:holes.append(h)
# associated 1 components
ones={(i,j) for i in range(R) for j in range(C) if a[i][j]==1};vis=set();components=[]
for p in ones:
 if p in vis:continue
 q=[p];vis.add(p);c=set()
 while q:
  x,y=q.pop();c.add((x,y))
  for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
   z=x+dx,y+dy
   if z in ones and z not in vis:vis.add(z);q.append(z)
 if any((x+dx,y+dy) in h for x,y in c for h in holes for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):components.append(c)
out=[r[:] for r in a]
# enclosed interiors turn 3 except central pixel(s) stay 0
for h in holes:
 xs=[x for x,y in h];ys=[y for x,y in h];cx=(min(xs)+max(xs))/2;cy=(min(ys)+max(ys))/2
 center=min(h,key=lambda z:((z[0]-cx)**2+(z[1]-cy)**2,z[0],z[1]))
 for x,y in h:out[x][y]=3
 out[center[0]][center[1]]=0
# outer bounding frame one cell outside each associated contour bbox
for c in components:
 r0=min(x for x,y in c)-1;r1=max(x for x,y in c)+1;c0=min(y for x,y in c)-1;c1=max(y for x,y in c)+1
 for x in range(max(0,r0),min(R,r1+1)):
  for y in range(max(0,c0),min(C,c1+1)):
   if x in (r0,r1) or y in(c0,c1):
    if a[x][y]==0:out[x][y]=2
print('components',[(min(x for x,y in c),max(x for x,y in c),min(y for x,y in c),max(y for x,y in c)) for c in components]);print('holes',[(len(h), sorted(h)[:4]) for h in holes]);import json;print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
